material_findings.title: Crypto World's Fair is a live cross-chain startup hackathon through October 12
material_findings.summary: Colosseum's current primary surface marks Crypto World's Fair live from Sep. 14 through Oct. 12, open globally across blockchain ecosystems. Solo founders may participate, pre-existing code is allowed with disclosure, and only competition-window work is judged. Winners receive non-dilutive prizes; select winners may enter Colosseum's accelerator with $250,000 in capital. The organizer announcement says hundreds of thousands in prizes and millions in venture funding are at stake, while detailed track prize amounts are still being released.
